scriptData.label: Roll to remove Stunned
@effect.name
Amputated Arm

description.label: Description
description.value:
Your sneaky nemesis manages to slam his weapon in under your arm, severing the large brachial artery. Have you made your peace with Morr?

Effects: Gain @Condition[Stunned] (2) and @Condition[Bleeding] (3), the latter of which requires Surgery to remove. Should you fail to bleed to death the arm will remain useless due to a wrecked brachial nerve plexus (see under @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.MnMZv7ZXoRqoH9dS]{Amputated Parts}).
